In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/origin/pull/31025):

>Current https://prow.ci.openshift.org/job-history/gs/prow-artifact-archive/logs/periodic-ci-openshift-release-main-ci-4.22-upgrade-from-stable-4.21-from-stable-4.20-e2e-aws-ovn-upgrade is broken with
>
>```
>: [Monitor:apiserver-incluster-availability][Jira:"kube-apiserver"] monitor test apiserver-incluster-availability setup expand_less	1m1s
>{  failed during setup
>unable to determine openshift-tests image: registry.build09.ci.openshift.org/ci-op-ig5jr2tm/release@sha256:c5a33a11e09de6c07f7ba449b9d3da7a45b3fa16194a879b35308319998ba5e9,registry.build09.ci.openshift.org/ci-op-ig5jr2tm/release@sha256:4c2716961dfe4b428bd239d6aa8e1647b3ab0a4419582f3e058cb6071299a0b2: failed to extract image references from release payload: failed extracting image-references from "registry.build09.ci.openshift.org/ci-op-ig5jr2tm/release@sha256:c5a33a11e09de6c07f7ba449b9d3da7a45b3fa16194a879b35308319998ba5e9,registry.build09.ci.openshift.org/ci-op-ig5jr2tm/release@sha256:4c2716961dfe4b428bd239d6aa8e1647b3ab0a4419582f3e058cb6071299a0b2": error during image extract: exit status 1 (error: "registry.build09.ci.openshift.org/ci-op-ig5jr2tm/release@sha256:c5a33a11e09de6c07f7ba449b9d3da7a45b3fa16194a879b35308319998ba5e9,registry.build09.ci.openshift.org/ci-op-ig5jr2tm/release@sha256:4c2716961dfe4b428bd239d6aa8e1647b3ab0a4419582f3e058cb6071299a0b2" is not a valid image reference: invalid reference format
>)}
>```
>
>It might be related to https://github.com/openshift/origin/commit/88e9c10a7141bc4c10f584c73463bc6fc77135bf because https://prow.ci.openshift.org/view/gs/prow-artifact-archive/logs/periodic-ci-openshift-release-main-ci-4.20-upgrade-from-stable-4.19-from-stable-4.18-e2e-aws-ovn-upgrade/2043738707252482048 has the issue while https://prow.ci.openshift.org/view/gs/prow-artifact-archive/logs/periodic-ci-openshift-release-main-ci-4.19-upgrade-from-stable-4.18-from-stable-4.17-e2e-aws-ovn-upgrade/2041201572150513664 has not.
>
>```console
>$ git --no-pager branch -a --contains 88e9c10a7141bc4c10f584c73463bc6fc77135bf | grep origin
>    remotes/origin/HEAD -> origin/main
>    remotes/origin/main
>    remotes/origin/release-4.20
>    remotes/origin/release-4.21
>    remotes/origin/release-4.22
>    remotes/origin/release-4.23
>    remotes/origin/release-5.0
>```
>
>Ideally we should fix it but a healthy CI by skipping one particular upgrade suite sounds like an improvement.
